0.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_000
0.description: I thank you again for your vote of confidence, friend! Here's hoping that the others share your high opinion of my proposal...

1.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_001
1.description: You may have been less than convinced by my words of passion, but I remain confident that your peers will make the proper choice. Just you wait and see─Bert the Beloved shall win the day!

2.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_002
2.description: I have listened to both Bert's and Astrid's proposals, and─much as expected─I found them to be rather lacking. I know not what you saw in them, but I am quite certain the rest of the citizens will cast the logical vote.

3.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_003
3.description: Did you hear!? The votes have been counted, and I've been declared the victor! Oh, thank you, my friend─I could never have done it without your vote of confidence.

4.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_100_003
4.description: Did you hear!? The votes have been counted, and I've been declared the victor!

5.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_004
5.description: Could it be that I'm not as beloved as I thought!? Either way, there's no use crying over spilled mead. If Astrid needs my support, she can consider it hers!

6.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_005
6.description: My heart cannot agree with the results of the voting, but my head tells me I must accept the fair judgment of the masses. Rest assured that I intend to offer Astrid any assistance she requires.

7.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_006
7.description: From the Farreach to the Sea of Ash, hearts pine and─ Oh, it's you! Forgive me, I was simply trying to get into the spirit now that I've been named Sister's successor. May ardor and affection follow wheresoever you go!

8.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_010
8.description: Ah! There you are! Rest assured that your vote won't go for naught. From the word about town, it's all but a done deal─Bert the Beloved has this contest in the bag!

9.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_011
9.description: Pray tell me, friend─what was it about my proposal that you found less than convincing? I really did give it quite a bit of thought, you know...

10.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_012
10.description: I have listened to both Bert's and Astrid's proposals, and─much as expected─I found them to be rather lacking. I know not what you saw in them, but I am quite certain the rest of the citizens will cast the logical vote.

11.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_013
11.description: Bahahaha! What did I tell you? Good ol' Bert's proposal was beloved by one and all! Allow me to thank you again, my friend. Your confidence in my cause fanned the flames of passion within me like nothing before!

12.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_100_013
12.description: Bahahaha! What did I tell you? Good ol' Bert's proposal was beloved by one and all!

13.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_014
13.description: I must confess that the results of the contest were more than a bit disheartening, but so be it. I will redouble my efforts next time, that I might at last do Sister proud. As for now, I am happy to support Bert in whatever small way I can.

14.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_015
14.description: My heart cannot agree with the results of the voting, but my head tells me I must accept the fair judgment of the masses. Rest assured that I intend to offer Bert any assistance he requires.

15.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_016
15.description: Today marks the dawning of a new era, for Bert the Beloved shall lead the lovers of Eorzea into an age of bold, burning passion! I cannot thank you enough, friend. May you enjoy the fabulous future that you helped to forge!

16.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_020
16.description: More than any, I knew that you would see reason. I can only hope that the rest of the masses are as logically grounded as you, my friend.

17.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_021
17.description: Pray tell me, friend─what was it about my proposal that you found less than convincing? I really did give it quite a bit of thought, you know...

18.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_022
18.description: You may have been less than convinced by my words of passion, but I remain confident that your peers will make the proper choice. Just you wait and see─Bert the Beloved shall win the day!

19.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_023
19.description: As any logical mind would have predicted, it would seem that I have been declared the winner. I thank and commend you for being one of the first to see the merits of my proposal.

20.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_100_023
20.description: As any logical mind would have predicted, it would seem that I have been declared the winner.

21.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_ASTRID_000_024
21.description: I must confess that the results of the contest were more than a bit disheartening, but so be it. I will redouble my efforts next time, that I might at last do Sister proud. As for now, I am happy to support Rodrigault in whatever small way I can.

22.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_BERT_000_025
22.description: Could it be that I'm not as beloved as I thought!? Either way, there's no use crying over spilled mead. If Rodrigault needs my support, he can consider it his!

23.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_RODRIGAULT_000_026
23.description: For too long, love has been the domain of the romantic fool. Under my watch as emissary of ardor, I will see that many a match is made the way it was intended: between like-minded souls who can logically understand the affinity they feel for one another.

24.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_LISETTE_000_030
24.description: Where, oh where is an adventurer of repute and renown when you need <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>...?

25.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_SYSTEM_100_030
25.description: In order to undertake the quest “Of Ardor and Argument,” you must first complete the quest “It's Probably Pirates.”

26.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_LISETTE_000_031
26.description: Choose the man or woman whose proposal you feel best embodies the spirit of Valentione's Day, and pray lead that individual to me. I shall be ever so tickled to see who you choose!

27.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_LISETTE_000_032
27.description: It is still far too early to declare the contest won. There are countless other adventurers and Gridanian citizens who have yet to weigh in, after all. When the final results have been counted and compiled, pray speak with me anew.

28.name: TEXT_FESVLT2020EVANGELIST_00651_LISETTE_000_033
28.description: Greetings, my beloved friend! I trust you are enjoying the festivities to your heart's content. Have you found your own true love yet? Should you find yourself alone this Valentione's Day, why not try your hand at the ceremony? It may very well be the first step on the romantic adventure of a lifetime!
